name: tight-70s
description: Tight 1970s drum-bus tone — Neve 1073 (80 Hz HPF + 3.2 kHz snare-crack presence + 60 Hz kick weight) → dbx 160 (fast VCA punch, 6:1) → Studer A800 30 IPS tape (tight low end, less head-bump). Built on a close-mic-forward / room-low (dry) bus with a shape-bands transient pre-pass. Moderate stereo (70s, not mono). Built & verified 2026-05-31.
intended_for: a stereo drum bus — for max tightness, transient-emphasize first (shape-bands: attack up, low-mid tamed), then apply this
plugin_build: uaudio_*.vst3 (UADx native — the build that renders headless; not the UAD ….component twins)

target_signature.comment: measured tight-70s output on the reference drum bus; sanity-check a re-apply

notes: Neve EQ is OFF by default — eql='In' engages it. hp_filt/lf_freq/mf_freq are enum strings; dbx compress is an enum string (' 6.0:1', leading space); studer ips/tape_type are enum strings, auto_cal is a bool — all set via the preset harness (apply-vst-chain's float dict can't).
The +16 dB gain-stage drives the Neve/dbx/Studer (the bus is quiet); without it they barely engage.
Pairs with a shape-bands transient pass for the 'tight' attack; apply this preset to that shaped bus.
